verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents STT as a pluggable interface: developers can pick providers through its open-source plugin ecosystem or LiveKit Inference, and can override the API key and base URL for STT. That gives direct control over the STT provider. The pack does not show transcription accuracy, choice of STT language or model, or key-term boosting. Missing for 10: evidence of transcription accuracy, STT model/language selection controls, key-term or custom-vocabulary support, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time transcription quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: For any provider not included, you can override the API key and base URL at initialization for the LLM, STT, and TTS interfaces in the plugin.
you can use the open source plugins to connect directly to a wider range of model providers.
LiveKit Agents includes a large ecosystem of open source plugins for a variety of AI providers.
